text.formatted: You can cast any spell as a Ritual if that spell has the Ritual tag and the spell is in your spellbook. You needn't have the spell prepared, but you must read from the book to cast a spell in this way.
text.plain: You can cast any spell as a Ritual if that spell has the Ritual tag and the spell is in your spellbook. You needn't have the spell prepared, but you must read from the book to cast a spell in this way.

gaps.name: Reading from the book during the Ritual remains a live prose prerequisite.

prose.text: Read from your spellbook to cast this Ritual.

gap.name: Reading from the spellbook while casting this Ritual.
